items.source: @NoRepositoryBean public interface ListPagingAndSortingRepository<T,ID> extends PagingAndSortingRepository<T,ID>
items.translation: @NoRepositoryBean public interface ListPagingAndSortingRepository<T,ID> extends PagingAndSortingRepository<T,ID>

items.source: Repository fragment to provide methods to retrieve entities using the pagination and sorting abstraction. This an extension to PagingAndSortingRepository returning List instead of Iterable where applicable.
items.translation: 提供使用分页和排序抽象检索实体的方法的存储库片段。这是 PagingAndSortingRepository 的扩展，在适用情况下返回 List 而不是 Iterable。
